components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink pill button for primary invitation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #573E28; color: #FBF4EA; font-family: "Outfit", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 16px 24px; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgb(87 62 40 / .55); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6a4c31; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7D5A10; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Pill button with a paper surface and ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #FBF4EA; color: #573E28; font-family: "Outfit", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgb(87 62 40 / .3); border-radius: 9999px; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(87 62 40 / .05); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7D5A10; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Rounded text field on a paper surface with a gold focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FBF4EA; color: #573E28; font-family: "Outfit", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid rgb(87 62 40 / .25); border-radius: 12px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #7D5A10; outline: none; } .ds-input:disabled { background: rgb(87 62 40 / .05); color: #6B5440; }

components.name: Nav Chip
components.description: Fixed bottom navigation chip with muted default and paper active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-chip { background: transparent; color: #6B5440; font-family: "Outfit", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 56px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-chip[aria-current="true"] { color: #FBF4EA; background: #573E28; } .ds-nav-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7D5A10; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: QR Dialog
components.description: Centered modal dialog for guest QR display.
components.css: .ds-dialog { max-width: min(92vw, 360px); background: #FBF4EA; color: #573E28; border: none; border-radius: 24px; padding: 0; } .ds-dialog::backdrop { background: rgb(40 26 14 / .6); } .ds-dialog-form { position: relative; padding: 24px; text-align: center; } .ds-dialog-close { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #573E28; cursor: pointer; } .ds-qr { min-height: 180px; margin: 16px auto 0; width: fit-content; }

components.name: Loader
components.description: Full-screen cream overlay that holds a padded monogram before invitation content is ready.
components.css: .loader { background: #F3E1CF; color: #573E28; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px; } .loader__monogram { font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; line-height: 1; animation: loader-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .loader__rule { display: block; margin: 16px auto 0; height: 1px; width: 96px; background: #D1A046; } @keyframes loader-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

narrative.overview: inviotee is a warm, ceremonial invitation system built as narrow mobile pages with cream and paper surfaces, ink typography, restrained gold accents, and Chinese-Javanese ornament used as framing rather than decoration. Formal serif headlines sit over compact UI copy, with clear focus states, tap targets, and brief gated motion.
keyCharacteristics: Brown ink typography with antique gold accents
Pill buttons and modest container radii

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ink carries hierarchy and action; gold is rare enough to remain meaningful, and seal red is reserved for ornamental moments.

rules.name: The Mobile Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Keep body copy compact and generous in line height so guest flows remain readable on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Soft Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by default. Soft shadow and rings appear for separation, not decoration.

dos: Do use cream, paper, ink, and gold as the core palette, with seal red only as ornament.
Do keep the mobile-first 480px frame and 44px tap targets.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for display and Outfit for UI text.
Do keep UI motion under 300ms and gated for reduced motion and coarse pointers.
Do preserve hover/focus feedback, including for reduced-motion users.
donts: Don't introduce unrelated saturated colors into the warm paper palette.
Don't use loud or excessive decorative motion.
Don't remove hover or focus feedback entirely.
Don't hardcode guest-specific content that belongs in src/content/<theme>.json.
Don't treat built dist/ artifacts as source.
